Repository: /private/var/folders/11/m_kwnqr97632l_cjt0mhytvh0000gn/T/pstack-corpus-ur5cbW/20-PROMPT-HOW-READONLY-EXPLORERS-r1/cursor/work

## Question
> How does this repository's git storage work end to end? Cover how HEAD, the refs, the index, and the object store fit together to produce README.md in the working tree.

## Your Exploration Angle
Trace HEAD and reference resolution in this concrete repository. Inspect .git/HEAD, loose and packed refs, relevant logs/config where useful, and use read-only Git plumbing commands. Explain exactly how Git reaches the current commit and where branch identity versus commit identity is stored. Connect the resolved commit to the next storage layer, but leave detailed object and index analysis to other explorers.

## Output

### Components Found
The key types, services, classes, and abstractions. For each: name, file path, and a one-sentence description of what it does.

### Flow
The execution flow step by step. For each step: what command/storage lookup runs, what file it's in, what it does, what it calls or resolves next. Include the data that flows between steps.

### Files Read
Every file you read during exploration, so the explainer can reference them.

### Boundaries
Where this subsystem connects to other parts of the repository. The inputs and outputs.

### Non-Obvious Things
Anything surprising, historically motivated, or easy to get wrong. Things that look like they should work one way but work another.

### Open Questions
Anything you couldn't fully trace or understand. Be honest about gaps.
</user_query>
I'll trace HEAD and reference resolution in this repository only, using read-only inspection of `.git` and Git plumbing.

input.command: git rev-parse --git-dir && echo "--- HEAD file ---" && git rev-parse --git-path HEAD && echo "--- symbolic-ref ---" && git symbolic-ref -q HEAD; echo "exit:$?" && echo "--- rev-parse HEAD ---" && git rev-parse HEAD && echo "--- rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD ---" && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && echo "--- show-ref ---" && git show-ref && echo "--- packed-refs exists? ---" && git rev-parse --git-path packed-refs && echo "--- config ---" && git config --local --list && echo "--- status porcelain ---" && git status --porcelain=v1 -b && echo "--- log -1 ---" && git log -1 --format=fuller
input.description: Read-only git plumbing for HEAD resolution
